//CricketScoreAnalyzer
package Practice;
import java.util.*;
public class CricketScoreAnalyzer {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in);
		
		System.out.print("Enter no. of batsmen: ");
		int n=sc.nextInt();
		
		int hs=0;
		int ls=0;
		int avg=0;
		int[] arr=new int[n];
		
		System.out.print("Enter the score scored by batsmen: "); 
		for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
			arr[i]=sc.nextInt();
		}
		
		Arrays.sort(arr);
		
		System.out.println("Lowest score: "+arr[0]);
		System.out.println("Highest score: "+arr[n-1]);
		
		for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
			avg+=arr[i];
		}
		avg/=n;
		System.out.println("Average score: "+avg);
		
		for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
			if(arr[i]>=100) {
				System.out.println(arr[i]+" is century");
			}
		}
	}

}
